notes.title: 🌟🎮 THE INDIE HOUSES STEAM EVENT: CELEBRATING WOMEN IN GAMING! 🎮🌟
notes.content:
Join us from [u][b]May 25-31[/b][/u] for an exciting weeklong celebration of women in gaming as [url=https://theindiehouses.org/][b]The Indie Houses[/b][/url] proudly presents the Women in Gaming Steam Event, in collaboration with [url=https://www.gmgsf.org/]Girls Make Games[/url]. This event aims to support the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund and empower the next generation of game creators.

We are thrilled to announce that we are collaborating alongside some incredible partners.
Together with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/akuparagames]Akupara Games[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/fellowtraveller?snr=1_7_15__13]Fellow Traveller[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/togeproductions?snr=1_7_15__13]Toge Productions[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/whitethorngames?snr=1_7_15__13]Whithethorn Games[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rawfury?snr=1_7_15__13]Raw Fury[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/thoseawesomeguys?snr=1_7_15__13]Those Awesome Guys[/url], we are determined to make a lasting impact.

During this event, we will showcase over 60 incredible games that feature women-led development teams and/or female protagonists. Prepare to immerse yourself in captivating experiences from studios such as [i]Kaigan Games[/i], creators of the acclaimed [i]SIMULACRA [/i]series; [i]Keybol Games[/i], the brilliant minds behind [i]Jack Axe[/i]; and [i]GameChanger Studio[/i], the masterminds behind the hauntingly beautiful [i]My Lovely Wife[/i] and [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985780/Jack_Axe?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011190/SIMULACRA_2?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925970/SIMULACRA_3?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100704
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930/My_Lovely_Wife?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100704


Throughout the event, you'll have the opportunity to explore demos and enjoy special discounts on a wide selection of titles. In addition, we've dedicated a section on the event page to Girls Make Games, where you can learn more about their impactful work and discover the incredible games that girls have created through their program.


[i]By participating in The Indie Houses Steam Event, you're not only indulging in fantastic gaming experiences, but you're also contributing to a meaningful cause. A portion of the proceeds earned by each publisher during the event will be donated to the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund. This fund combines professional development and financial support, ensuring that underrepresented students have early access to STEAM programs and the opportunity to thrive.

Girls Make Games has been providing an inclusive space for girls and non-binary students to explore the world of video games since 2014. Through their summer camps, workshops, and other initiatives, they have empowered over 23,000 girls in nearly 150 cities across 20 countries. To learn more about their inspiring mission, visit their website at [url=https://www.gmgsf.org]https://www.gmgsf.org[/url].

Don't miss out on this incredible event celebrating the talented women in gaming! Join us from May 25-31 on Steam, and let's make a difference together. Together, we're shaping a brighter and more inclusive future for the gaming industry.[/i]

🔗 Event Page: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/theindiehouses2023

🔗 Girls Make Games: https://www.gmgsf.org

notes.title: SIMULACRA 3 REVEAL!
notes.content:
[h1]Beware the Beldam![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734168/6aea361a12e6c7a454507c36a86489b9418d226e.gif[/img]

[i]Kaigan Games[/i] and [i]Neon Doctrine[/i] are excited to announce the third chapter of their critically acclaimed found phone horror series, Simulacra. 
[b]We invite you to explore a charming little town, and a new frontier of digital horror.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734168/0b7eb53b80bbd12107c5a0c591a923f2990bf90d.png[/img]

[i]The once charming town of Stonecreek has seen better days. People are vanishing into thin air, leaving nothing behind but strange symbols where they were last seen. With the police baffled and the populace terrified, rumors swirl that it is the doing of the Beldam, the ghost of a witch that once haunted the streets of Stonecreek[/i]
[previewyoutube=xUl0Qr4DWjA;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]You are the intern at the local paper, tasked with assisting the town’s star journalist, Ruby Myers, on her investigation into the disappearances. Your only lead is the phone of the missing Paul Castillo, a software developer, an amateur historian of the town, and one of Ruby’s sources. While Ruby does the legwork, your job is to hack into Paul’s phone for any clues left behind. New apps, exciting features, and fresh terror await those who delve into the darkest corners of the digital realms as you investigate the Beldam of Stonecreek.[/i]

notes.title: SIMULACRA is now available for MacOS! (and other small updates)
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

Just some small quality of life updates to accommodate for more devices.

[b] MAC OS VERSION AVAILABLE NOW [/b]
We know that this is long overdue, but hopefully, it's better late than never. SIMULACRA is now available on MacOS. You can get it on Steam or from Apple iTunes.

[b] WINDOWED MODE [/b]
SIMULACRA simulates a mobile phone and with that, it occupies barely a third of your screen. While the game does lock it to the center, we feel that some people might want to play it on the side while doing other tasks.

You can now enter windowed mode anytime by pressing ALT+ENTER for Windows or ⌥ + RETURN for Mac.

[b] JUNE 24TH [/b]
June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th June 24th
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30893666/d6f2a85cd22ed835e03b3ff1df123594e94c36e4.png[/img]


That's all folks.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Christmas Update - BEGIN +, Subtitles and SALE!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30893666/87a2de4f4caf0ded51310b1eb0d8f2cabd323a49.gif[/img]

In case you didn't know, SIMULACRA is having a 30% discount in conjunction with Steam's winter sale. With that, we also included some quality of life improvements of the game.

[b] BEGIN + [/b]
After completing the game for the very first time, you have to play the game again in "BEGIN + " mode. It will dramatically increase the text speed for a quicker playthrough to get the multiple endings. Of course, this is not recommended if you still prefer the complete immersive experience

[b] SUBTITLES [/b]
We messed up on this one. While SIMULACRA is mostly a text-based game, we do have FMV and voice messages scattered throughout. We checked the "subtitles" box without considering that players with hearing impairments will miss out these specific contents. We have since corrected this and enable an option to turn on subtitles. Just go to the HELP section in the Main Menu and turn it on. We want as many people to enjoy this game and hope that this feature will make that easier.

That's all for this year. For more news on the game, you know where to find us :)

notes.title: SIMULACRA awarded Excellence in Storytelling
notes.content:
SIMULACRA was presented the "Excellence in Storytelling Award" by the 2nd International Mobile Game Award SEA. 

The award was the result of a jury of industry’s experts, journalists and top developers selected 13 titles from a shortlist of 65 nominees.

The jury of the 2nd IMGA SEA commented: “Generally speaking we are happy to see important improvements in the quality of games created in Southeast Asia and we are hoping to see and award real innovation from the region in the future. The winning games achieved a high level of polish and we expect that to be a standard for games that are released be it from big or small teams. This can avoid early failure in the marketplace, build success and win awards!”.

On a related note, SIMULACRA is also one of the finalists for the upcoming [url=http://indieprize.org/kyiv2017/#entry-23]Indie Prize Kyiv[/url]. Do drop by Casual Connect and check out our booth!
